name: Reading digest
description: Summarize the circle's recent notes into a digest report, with a little outside context on the book.

toolsets.reason: Find reception and background on the current book for the context section.

steps.name: Gather
steps.prompt: Use read_file on circle.json and on every notes/ file from the last two weeks. Collect what the circle actually discussed: themes, disagreements, favorite passages. Then use the web-search tools once or twice for reception or background on the current book worth one short paragraph. Keep working notes with write_task_note.

steps.name: Write the digest
steps.prompt: Write the digest with write_artifact to reports/reading-digest.md. Sections: What we read, What we said (grounded in the notes, quoting members only where the notes quote them), A little context (from the search), and Questions for next time. Keep it under a page.
